retainedFailure.error: RuntimeError: Image 'Render Result' does not have any image data

diagnosis.cause: The active production Scene completed the first headless render with write_still=false, but Blender 5.2 exposed the Render Result data-block without image data that Image.save_render could consume.
diagnosis.priorRepositoryEvidence: B61-D5 already proved this exact headless Render Result limitation and separately proved that an OIIO-decoded Combined RGBA array can populate a generated Blender float image which an isolated review Scene can encode as PNG.
diagnosis.correctionToC4Reasoning: C4 incorrectly generalized the B61-D4 isolated-Scene storage proof from a generated image with data to the headless Render Result without data. The isolated Scene was valid; the assumed source image was not.

Decode the exact Combined RGBA subimage with Blender-bundled OpenImageIO 3.1.13.1 and NumPy 2.3.4; create one temporary float image in ACEScg with the proven OIIO-top-row to Blender-bottom-row conversion; save that generated image through the non-active PNG/RGBA/8 output Scene; then remove the generated image and scratch EXR before the next frame. Remove the empty scratch directory and output Scene at completion.
